title: Arrow detection with ConvNext pretrained on DINOv3 [P]
summary: Worked on this for about a month. I experimented a lot with resnets (pretrained on Imagenet) which performed quite well, pure ViT which performed worse. ConvNext DINOv3 performed the best. For data I rendered about 40000 varied blender scenes, and used 8000 labelled real images.
